author: bardic-inspiration
name: Legion Standard-Bearer
summary: The soldier who carries the legion's eagle, whose raised standard makes the whole cohort advance.
description: To lose the standard is the legion's greatest shame, so the standard-bearer is chosen from the toughest and the most stubborn. When the standard moves, the cohort moves with it.

traits.name: Eagle Standard
traits.text: Each ally within 30 feet of the standard-bearer that can see the standard has {ref:glossary/advantage} on saving throws against the {ref:condition/frightened} condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The standard-bearer makes two Pike attacks.

damage.condition: if an ally of the standard-bearer is within 5 feet of the target

bonusActions.name: Sound the Advance
bonusActions.text: Each ally within 30 feet of the standard-bearer that can see the standard can move up to half its Speed without provoking {ref:glossary/opportunity-attacks}.
